# State

Show the states of a system and the transitions between them.

## Example 1

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    ---
    config:
      theme: default
      look: classic
      layout: dagre
    ---
    stateDiagram-v2
      [*] --> Draft
      Draft --> Submitted : submit
      state Review {
        [*] --> Screening
        Screening --> Decision
      }
      Submitted --> Review
      Review --> Published : approved
      Review --> Draft : rejected
      Published --> [*]
    ```

=== "Markdown"

    ````markdown
    ```mermaid
    ---
    config:
      theme: default
      look: classic
      layout: dagre
    ---
    stateDiagram-v2
      [*] --> Draft
      Draft --> Submitted : submit
      state Review {
        [*] --> Screening
        Screening --> Decision
      }
      Submitted --> Review
      Review --> Published : approved
      Review --> Draft : rejected
      Published --> [*]
    ```
    ````

## Example 2

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    stateDiagram-v2
        [*] --> Active

        state Active {
            [*] --> NumLockOff
            NumLockOff --> NumLockOn : EvNumLockPressed
            NumLockOn --> NumLockOff : EvNumLockPressed
            --
            [*] --> CapsLockOff
            CapsLockOff --> CapsLockOn : EvCapsLockPressed
            CapsLockOn --> CapsLockOff : EvCapsLockPressed
            --
            [*] --> ScrollLockOff
            ScrollLockOff --> ScrollLockOn : EvScrollLockPressed
            ScrollLockOn --> ScrollLockOff : EvScrollLockPressed
        }
    ```

=== "Markdown"

    ````markdown
    ```mermaid
    stateDiagram-v2
        [*] --> Active

        state Active {
            [*] --> NumLockOff
            NumLockOff --> NumLockOn : EvNumLockPressed
            NumLockOn --> NumLockOff : EvNumLockPressed
            --
            [*] --> CapsLockOff
            CapsLockOff --> CapsLockOn : EvCapsLockPressed
            CapsLockOn --> CapsLockOff : EvCapsLockPressed
            --
            [*] --> ScrollLockOff
            ScrollLockOff --> ScrollLockOn : EvScrollLockPressed
            ScrollLockOn --> ScrollLockOff : EvScrollLockPressed
        }
    ```
    ````
